note: Synthetic fixture for the offline fetch bench, plumbing only, not evidence of real ranking accuracy. A fake catalog of 15 short entries in the shape a skills index or tools catalog actually has, 20 request -> expected-id cases, plus 5 no-match cases (expectedId null, noMatch true) that nothing in the catalog serves,, phrased closer to how a real user asks than to the catalog's own wording.

catalog.text: Pay a Con Edison electric bill via the guest pay-as-guest flow on coned.com. No login needed.
Place a cash-secured put option on Robinhood, live, on a per-ticket go from the operator.
Sell a covered call on Robinhood, buying the backing shares first if needed.
Check a draft reply or claim against the evidence it is supposed to be carried by before it is sent.
Check a worker agent's final report against machine-collected evidence before trusting it.
Run every question over a pile of records bigger than one provider call, with a coverage proof.
Post, reply to, or edit the profile of the fleet's X/Twitter account.
Buy a single item on Kelvin's personal Amazon account through the product page's Buy Now button.
Produce a short-form comic video from a script and starter images.
Look up recent sold prices for an item on eBay Terapeak, read-only.
Produce a full twelve-section dossier grading one stock for the options wheel.
Run a no-install graphics stress test on any connected Mac.
Pay a tenant's monthly rent on the Eshco ManageGo portal from the checking account on file.
Curate and trim a prompt card that has grown too large, on a fifteen-day cron or on demand.
Restart one team agent through the GUI control endpoint, with a checkpoint and a verify step.
